candidates.name: absence-driven Dempster pruning ladder on C
candidates.signature_and_transform: Dempster combined belief at each C dot using metric-kernel BPA with tip-family absence evidence; emit pruned ladders keep{Bel >= 0.90, 0.95, 0.99}
candidates.why_missing_faults: removal of sub-break-even dots is the proven lever (A->B->C ladder +0.0108 for ~3,900 zero-credit deletions); tip disagreement is the only independent estimate of which other C dots are sub-bar
candidates.difference_from_repository: every prior fusion was additive or re-weighting; no artifact has removed C dots using the other family's evidence
candidates.data_obtainable: YES, both parents pinned and local
candidates.expected_dti: +0.002 to +0.005 if half of the 6,040 C-only dots are sub-bar; -0.003 if they carry average credit
candidates.cost: low (one script); needs ONE live slot
candidates.kill_criterion: first rung tau=0.99...0.90; stop and declare dead if the first rung returns below 0.2727

candidates.name: 3 m DEM channel-knickpoint clusters
candidates.layers: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM via .github/workflows/dem-region-scarp.yml (706/716 zone-11 tiles already proven), block-averaged to 3 m
candidates.signature_and_transform: stream extraction on the 3 m mosaic; knickpoints as profile second-derivative maxima above a 3-sigma noise floor; RANSAC azimuth-coherent clustering; one Poisson dot per cluster centroid
candidates.why_missing_faults: base-level perturbation leaves knickpoints upstream of any mappable scarp, including alluvium-mantled faults with no surface trace in the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue
candidates.difference_from_repository: H52/H54 detected hillslope steps; no channel-profile operator exists in src/

candidates.name: conduit stepping-stone trace propagation
candidates.signature_and_transform: pair tier>=2 anchors within 15 cells; score straight segments by mean band-3 HG; emit dots along top segments, >=300 m from C
candidates.why_missing_faults: conduits are point evidence; the trace connecting them is what the 300 m kernel rewards and the surface-trace catalogue lacks
candidates.difference_from_repository: H55-A dart-threw isolated anchors; no session has connected anchors into traces

candidates.name: radiometric K-residual alteration halos
candidates.signature_and_transform: robust regression K ~ Th; residual z >= 2 AND band-3 HG >= p75 conjunction
candidates.why_missing_faults: potassic metasomatism along buried upflow zones persists under cover; the catalogue is a surface-trace compilation
candidates.difference_from_repository: H50-B used Th/K ratios in DS conflict corridors; GEMSDOE46 used scarp-radiometric coincidence; H53-RadEdge used radiometric edges; a lithology-regressed K residual is a different operator
candidates.data_obtainable: YES, mirror local and hash-pinned; uint8 quantisation flagged as risk

candidates.name: cover-gated additions (basement-depth prior)
candidates.layers: official band 15 (depth to basement) as a sampling gate on any addition
candidates.signature_and_transform: gate future additions to basement depth above the moat median; re-measure
candidates.why_missing_faults: catalogue incompleteness is maximal under thick cover; C under-emits deep basins (402.4 m mean depth vs 534.9 m moat; 42.5% of C below moat median)
candidates.difference_from_repository: H55-C used depth as a conjunction detector; this uses it as a sampling prior on additions
candidates.data_obtainable: YES, band 15 in restored official raster
